_note: The Read + Think choice board, as six Bloom levels with three options each. The board Stephanie uses is written for stories -- name the characters, draw the setting, write a new chapter -- and none of that works on 'The Radium Dial Painters'. This is the same structure rewritten for informational text, so every task can be done with any article in the store. Pick one from each row.
title: Read + Think
blurb: Pick ONE idea from each row. Think first, then do it.

tasks.d: Write them down and what each one means.
Say in one sentence what this text is about.
Write down every fact that has a number in it.
Tell what happened using your own words.
Give the main idea of the whole text in one sentence.
Pick a paragraph and say what job it does for the text.
Explain it to a person who has not read it.
Make a labelled diagram of the thing the text describes.
Name one place outside this text where this idea shows up.
Make two columns: what happened, and what it caused.
Sort three sentences into proved and only stated.
Tell how two paragraphs are alike and different.
Give the strongest fact 5 stars and the weakest 1. Say why.
What do you still want to know, and where would you look?
Say whether the point was proved, and how you can tell.
Write a title that is true and makes someone want to read.
Turn the text into a poster that teaches it to a class.
Write the paragraph that should come after the last one.
